import sys
from collections import defaultdict

stdin = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
N = int(stdin[0])
categories = {}
index = 1

for _ in range(N):
    line = stdin[index].split()
    category = line[0]
    W = int(line[1])
    words = set(line[2:])
    categories[category] = words
    index += 1

statement_words = set()
for line in stdin[index:]:
    statement_words.update(line.split())

category_counts = defaultdict(int)
for category, words in categories.items():
    for word in words:
        category_counts[category] += statement_words.count(word)

max_count = max(category_counts.values())
suggested_categories = [category for category, count in category_counts.items() if count == max_count]
suggested_categories.sort()

for category in suggested_categories:
    print(category)
